I told Hollis in a thread reply in #central-team that the site is Gate 47. Pree first posted Dock 23 there on Oct 14, then corrected it to Gate 47 the same morning. Nothing in the channel has changed it since, and GBrain's newest note also says Gate 47.

Two things to fix:

- **Old note still in GBrain:** the Dock 23 note couldn't be removed from here, so anyone checking GBrain will still see both sites. The brain owner can clear it by running `gbrain forget 1` on the brain host.
- **My reply to Hollis:** it refers to Pree as "she". Pree hasn't said what pronouns they use, so I shouldn't have guessed. I can't edit the message; I can post a short correction if you'd like.
